quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: Oh... thank you for your kindness. But as a sister of the Church of Favonius, I cannot accept such gifts.

dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: For me, it is enough to breathe in a trace of this fragrance as it rides upon the sea wind. Beautiful things belong to the wind, not to any one person. That is the way of those who walk in faith.

dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: Even so, your kindness, warm as the southern breeze, has reached me. Please accept this book as a small return gift.

dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon watch over you. And may the road ahead be filled, like this fragrance, with virtue, freedom, and compassion.
